name: MyGPT-desktop
description: MyGPT - Privacy-First Retrieval-Augmented Generation Desktop Application
author: St. Jude Children's Research Hospital

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:ts
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && cross-env CUSTOM_DMGBUILD_PATH=./scripts/dmgbuild-with-retries.js DMGBUILD_DETACH_RETRIES=6 electron-builder --mac
scripts.docker:up: cd .. && docker compose up -d db backend grobid
